Experience powerful home audio with the Portronics Decibel 24 Soundbar, a sleek and compact solution designed to upgrade your TV, laptop, or smartphone sound instantly. Equipped with Bluetooth 5.3 for faster pairing and stable connectivity, this wireless 10W HD soundbar delivers clear vocals, enhanced bass, and room-filling performance. Whether you are watching movies, streaming music, or gaming, the soundbar creates an immersive environment with TWS surround sound support. The modern design, easy controls, and convenient Type-C charging port make it a perfect addition to contemporary homes and offices.

Built for users who want portability without compromising audio quality, the Portronics speaker system fits neatly under your TV or on your work desk. With multi-device compatibility and hassle-free setup, the Portronics Decibel 24 Soundbar is ideal for smart TVs, PCs, tablets, and mobile phones. Enjoy distortion-free sound, deep audio clarity, and seamless wireless streaming every day.

Key Features

  • 10W HD Output: Enjoy cinematic audio with balanced treble and punchy bass from a compact body.
  • Bluetooth 5.3: Faster pairing, low latency, and reliable wireless connectivity.
  • TWS Surround Sound: Pair two units to amplify your listening experience.
  • Type-C Charging Port: Quick and convenient charging with modern compatibility.
  • Portable & Stylish: Slim profile blends perfectly with TVs and workspace setups.
  • Wide Compatibility: Works with smartphones, laptops, desktops, and televisions.

The wireless 10W HD soundbar is engineered for dynamic sound performance in small to mid-sized rooms. From intense action scenes to soothing playlists, the audio remains crisp and detailed. Thanks to Bluetooth 5.3, you get improved range and energy efficiency, ensuring longer playback and fewer interruptions. If you crave a theatre-like feel, simply connect another unit and activate TWS surround sound for a broader, more powerful soundstage.

Convenience meets innovation with the integrated Type-C charging port, enabling fast power-ups using commonly available cables. The intuitive control panel allows easy volume adjustment, track change, and mode selection. Designed with durability and portability in mind, the can be moved from your living room to your bedroom or even carried for small gatherings.

Perfect for binge-watchers, gamers, and music lovers, this wireless 10W HD soundbar ensures you never miss subtle audio details. Dialogue becomes clearer, background scores feel richer, and every beat lands with precision. The latest Bluetooth 5.3 technology keeps your connection stable while minimizing lag, making it excellent for video streaming and gaming sessions.

Upgrade your entertainment setup with the and transform ordinary sound into an extraordinary experience. With expandable TWS surround sound, modern charging via the Type-C charging port, and elegant styling, this soundbar is a must-have gadget for today’s digital lifestyle.

Why Choose This Soundbar?

  • Compact yet powerful audio solution
  • Easy wireless music streaming
  • Ideal for TV, gaming, and office use
  • Modern connectivity with Type-C
  • Trusted Portronics build quality
